name: XlFormatConditionOperator
description: Specifies the operator to use to compare a formula against the value in a cell or, for xlBetween and xlNotBetween, to compare two formulas.

constants.name: xlBetween
constants.description: Between. Can be used only if two formulas are provided.

constants.name: xlNotBetween
constants.description: Not between. Can be used only if two formulas are provided.
